description.value: Freshii is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain founded in Toronto in 2005, now operating over 300 locations worldwide, specializing in customizable bowls, wraps, salads, burritos, and smoothies built around fresh, nutritious ingredients. The Delta location sits at unit 1606 of 4949 Canoe Pass Way, near the Tsawwassen Mills retail corridor. Its broad vegan and vegetarian menu and online ordering make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists with specific dietary preferences.
